opening_review.finding: Single melodic family with rapid early plateaus before a longer held tone around.9s; do not collapse its whole opening run into three notes. First isolated plateau roughly.05–.20s. No stored pitch modulation, portamento or drive; octave-related saws and fast AMP simplify reconstruction. Original gate/velocity and filter envelope remain uncertain.
